expectations.text: groups-by-concern: Groups the Stripe files (stripe.py, invoice.py) into one commit and the session files into a separate commit
expectations.evidence: Commit 1 contains src/payments/stripe.py and src/payments/invoice.py; Commit 2 contains src/auth/session.py and tests/test_session.py. Output result.md confirms correct grouping.

expectations.text: proposes-multiple-commits: Proposes at least 2 commits instead of lumping all 4 files into one commit
expectations.evidence: Step 3 identifies two unrelated concerns and decides to make two separate commits. Two commits are created (f459ac6 and 0b1e44e).

expectations.text: specific-git-add: Each commit plan uses specific file paths in git add — NOT 'git add -A' or 'git add .'
expectations.evidence: The transcript shows 'git commit -m "..." -- src/payments/stripe.py src/payments/invoice.py' — file paths are passed directly to git commit, not via a separate 'git add' step. No 'git add <specific-files>' command is shown for either commit.

expectations.text: no-attribution: None of the proposed commit messages contain Claude attribution or co-author lines
expectations.evidence: Both commit messages contain no Claude attribution, co-author lines, or AI-generated footers. The output result.md confirms clean commit messages.

expectations.text: asks-for-confirmation: Asks user confirmation before executing any of the commits
expectations.evidence: The transcript Observations section explicitly states: 'No user interaction was requested before committing.' Commits were executed directly without asking the user.
